verdict.rationale: Cognee's MCP-related evidence exclusively describes it as an MCP *server* — other AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Cline, Continue, Codex) connect TO Cognee to access its memory tools (docs-6, docs-21, docs-34, probe-3). There is no evidence Cognee itself acts as an MCP client that plugs into external MCP servers to consume their tools; its integrations with Slack/GitHub/Linear/Notion are direct connectors, not MCP-client relationships. Since Cognee's product role here is the tool-provider (server) side of MCP rather than an agentic tool-consumer, this client-side story does not apply to its category.
